low_q01.kind: raw error (lower is better); set = actual <= q01; n=42 prediction rows = 21 unique x 2 repeats

high_q90.kind: raw error (lower is better); set = actual > q90

v32.kind: score (higher is better); v3.2 full marks: local_order 35 / local_mae 15 / global_order 15 / global_mae 15 / top1_regret 20

in_sample.note: 全量 2048 行上的拟合值（in-sample，乐观，不能当泛化指标）

overall.kind: raw error (lower is better) (in-sample interpolation, NOT generalization)

r2_direction: higher is better (R2 is goodness of fit, not an error; only RMSE/MAE/bias in each block are 'raw error, lower is better')
low_q01_definition: actual <= q01 (=123.1244, numpy linear quantile) of the 2048 unique labels; 42 prediction rows = 21 unique x 2 repeats. Note: 122.875 is not q01: it is the 21st smallest label (exact 122.87519074) truncated to 3 decimals; {actual <= 122.875} has 20 unique rows / 40 prediction rows, while {actual <= q01=123.1244} has 21 unique / 42 rows
